column1: # ZAP baseline rule overrides for Honeywell Sales Suite frontend.
# Format:  <RULE_ID>
# Thresholds: IGNORE | INFO | WARN | FAIL
# All entries below downgrade Informational/Low advisories that are
# either irrelevant to a Vite-built React SPA on Render or are
# wired into the platform's default response headers (which we
# do not control from the app side).
# Real Medium+ findings still trigger a workflow failure via the
# jq fail-gate in .github/workflows/security-scan.yml.
# Rule IDs reference https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/alerts/.
# Re-examine Cache-control Directives — Render CDN headers, expected.
# Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments — flags benign comments
# in our bundled JS (react-query, recharts). Informational only.
# Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set on /robots.txt 404 —
# Render does not emit HSTS on 404 paths.
# Storable and Cacheable Content / Retrieved from Cache —
# expected behavior for hashed static assets.
# CSP: style-src unsafe-inline — required by React for inline style
# attributes. Backend CSP middleware enforces script-src nonce.
# Base64 Disclosure — bundled sourceMappingURL data URIs.
# Modern Web Application — informational marker, not a finding.
# Sub Resource Integrity Attribute Missing — Vite hashed chunks
# change per build; SRI is incompatible with our chunked SPA.
# Cross-Origin-Embedder/Opener/Resource-Policy Header Missing —
# Render's default response headers; not controllable from the app.
# Sec-Fetch-* Header is Missing — these are REQUEST headers, not
# response headers. ZAP misclassifies them here.
